consumer: mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) asking 'does crafting_inventory hold >=20 scrap?' to decide if the find-item objective is satisfied
scope: items reachable nearby for crafting (the character's carried items plus surrounding craftable reach via crafting_inventory), not only carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — tallies u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(scrap,20) and returns whether the count reaches the required amount
divergence: Avatar carries 15 scrap and has 10 more scrap reachable nearby (ground/adjacent vehicle within crafting reach): the correct craft-here predicate sees 25 (>=20) and reports complete, while a wrong on-person-only predicate sees 15 and reports incomplete
